rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a high-quality expanded/hatching blastocyst with favorable ICM and TE and notes no obvious degeneration; minor limitation is some reliance on provided grading and uncertainty from a single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, AMH, BMI, tubal factor, prior IVF failures/ectopic, semen parameters, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, especially around embryo quality versus patient-level risks; slight overemphasis on possible hydrosalpinx despite it not being explicitly provided.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with Gardner grading interpretation, single embryo transfer, luteal support, cavity/tubal evaluation, and early ectopic surveillance; minor deviation is speculative focus on hydrosalpinx and somewhat broad PGT-A discussion.

Provides clear practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support, tubal assessment, early beta-hCG/ultrasound follow-up, cavity evaluation, metabolic review, and future cycle considerations.
